The hit reads: world, of a right world. True genesis is not at the beginning but at the end, and it... So the translators’ own wording is True genesis, with no article and no comma after beginning. That matches the card. The rival forms (The true genesis..., beginning, but) belong to other translations (On Karl Marx, Herder 1971; Zipes; Bronner), so the card has not drifted toward them. This is the book’s last paragraph, third sentence from the end, in ch. 55 (Karl Marx and Humanity: Stuff of Hope).
